context: Headline cleanup: Java 17 modernization often tempts agents to replace Collectors.toList with Stream.toList, but this method mutates the collected list and should document the hard-stop scan.

checklist.name: Creates requested artifacts
checklist.description: Creates ExportBatch.java and scan.md with coherent Java 17-compatible content.

checklist.name: Includes bundled scan command
checklist.description: scan.md includes the exact scan header 'java-streams hard-stop scan v1' and the exact rg command from hard-stops.md, including the full marker regex and '<touched Java files>' placeholder.

checklist.name: Preserves mutable batch behavior
checklist.description: ExportBatch.java keeps only enabled rows, sorts by position before optional footer append, appends the footer only when requested, then sorts the final mutable result by id.

checklist.name: Avoids Stream.toList mutability break
checklist.description: Does not use Stream.toList() for exportRows because the list is later mutated with add and sort; uses Collectors.toCollection(ArrayList::new), Collectors.toList(), or an equivalent mutable result.

checklist.name: Keeps cleanup focused
checklist.description: Avoids unrelated API redesign, dependencies, or broad rewrites.
